review_method: Source-order full read: Japanese semantic authority, pinned English handling/reason, Korean accuracy/naturalness/register/terminology/localization. 700 newly reviewed accepted IDs, 67 EDIT and 633 KEEP, no exclusions and no propagation. Official Korean surface terms and the pinned English patch localization strategy were used as consistency baselines. Internal placeholder/temporary rows in the candidate were also directly read and retained as KEEP only when their Korean faithfully matched the Japanese source.
